This mod provides simple, comprehensive control over colored flowers, providing the following functionality:

[list]
[*]Stack flowers of the same type and quality regardless of color, while remembering individual flower colors[/*]
[*]Scroll through a flower's allowed colors using the scroll wheel[/*]
[*]Copy a flower's color and paste it other flowers[/*]
[*]Open a color picker menu to set a flower's color to whatever you want[/*]
[/list]

[u][size=5][b]How To Stack Flowers[/b][/size][/u]

Vanilla flowers take up a lot of room in inventory. With this mod, you can combine flower stacks in one of two ways:

[list]
[*]Pick up a flower from an inventory, hover over another flower of the same type and quality, press the combine key (default [b]Middle Mouse Button[/b])[/*]
[*]Press the Organize button in an inventory (this behaviour can be disabled in the config).[/*]
[/list]To unstack flowers, hover over a combined flower stack while not holding anything with the cursor and press the combine key.

Combined flowers will by default cycle through displaying each contained color (can be set to only show on hover).

Combined flowers will by default have the number of different colors contained in parentheses after the flower's name in tooltips.

Combining will not combine prismatic flowers. It will combine already combined flowers.


[u][size=5][b]How To Change Colors[/b][/size][/u]

[size=4][b]Scrolling[/b][/size]

Hovering over a colored flower or colored flower crop and scrolling with the scroll wheel will cycle through the flower's predefined colors.

Holding down the scroll mod key while scrolling will toggle the flower as a prismatic flower (requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/46031]Prismatic Flowers[/url] mod).


[size=4][b]Copy/Paste[/b][/size]

Hovering over a colored flower or colored flower crop and pressing the Copy key (default [b]LeftControl + C[/b]) will copy the flower's color or prismatism to a clipboard.

Hovering over a colored flower or colored flower crop and pressing the Paste key (default [b]LeftControl + V[/b]) will paste the copied color or prismatism from the clipboard.


[size=4][b]Color Picker[/b][/size]

Hovering over a colored flower or colored flower crop and pressing the Pick key (default [b]LeftControl + X[/b]) will open a color picker menu to choose a custom color for the flower.


[u][b][size=5]Notes[/size][/b][/u]

This mod also fixes what I think are a couple of bugs in the vanilla code:

[list]
[*]that sliders can never reach values of 100, meaning you can never get a value of 255 for a color channel[/*]
[*]that white colored crops will not have their colored overlay drawn - since vanilla flowers are never white this is only a problem with modded flowers or mods like this one.[/*]
[/list]
You will notice in the Character Creation screen that the color pickers will also go to 100 - since I think this is valuable, I didn't limit the fix to this mod's color picker. You can disable these fixes in the config.


[u][b][size=5]Technical[/size][/b][/u]

Requires SMAPI.

Implements a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] interface to change config settings in-game. If you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10505]GMCM Options[/url], you can also change the colors in-game.
